description: Turn the Pen tool into an Illustrator-style cubic-bezier curve tool: per-anchor in/out handles + a Corner/Smooth/Symmetric classification, click=corner / press-drag=smooth / Alt-drag=corner-break, plus a per-anchor 'corner settings' smoothness slider (0=sharp .. 1=round) that auto-derives collinear handles. Reuses the existing de Casteljau tessellation (node_manager/curve.rs) — a UI/interaction/persistence feature, NOT new curve math. All geometry stays in raw petal-local meters (no world_scale); legacy straight polylines decode as all-corner/no-handle and render byte-identically.
notes: User-directed 2026-07-22, as the answer to the Pen arm-grab code-review finding: 'it should show curves like in illustrator and allow the user to adjust the smoothness of a corner so basically corner settings'. SUPERSEDES the arm-grab finding — the Pen interaction model changes wholesale rather than getting a band-aid (the ratified 'grab wherever shown' rule for lone vertices/segments is untouched; handle markers become a strictly higher-priority claim ahead of it). Design produced by the pen-curve-tool-design workflow (4 grounded code-readers -> design -> adversarial critique; run wf_a7826e5e-6dc, ~602k tokens). Critique verdict: sound-with-fixes; all 3 sacred invariants verified RESPECTED (world_scale-free meter frame, two-authority selection split, legacy backward-compat). KEY SCOPE FINDING: the bezier->polyline->ribbon tessellation ALREADY EXISTS end-to-end (node_manager/curve.rs de Casteljau push_cubic + catmull_rom, already wired into the ribbon pipeline) — this track adds UI to place/drag control points + per-anchor persistence, NOT new tessellation math. TWO MUST-FIXES from the critique are baked into the plan: (1) the EDITABLE Pen tool-level default belongs in tool_panel.rs (which owns &mut ToolPanelState); tool_inspector.rs is read-only BY CONSTRUCTION and gets a read-only affordance ONLY — the design's original 'no &mut change to tool_inspector' claim was FALSE; (2) press-drag on the FIRST anchor of a NEW track must thread handle_out/in/corner through PendingPenCreate + the deferred NodeCreated echo, else a new curved track silently starts with a sharp corner. PHASE 1 (per-anchor bezier data model + 4/12-slot backward-compatible wire format) IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED GREEN 2026-07-23: clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings clean; all tests pass incl. 9 new tests (compact/full encode, legacy 4-slot decode, mixed-length, Open-Q6 normalization, JSON persistence); reviewed spec-faithful (two separate CornerKind enums, no world_scale, legacy round-trips 4-slot). PHASE 2 (anchor-bezier flatten_route in new fe-terrain/src/mesh/curve.rs, wired into render_gpx_tracks + track_pick_shape via a shared SAMPLES_PER_SEGMENT; track_mesh unchanged) ALSO IMPLEMENTED + VERIFIED GREEN 2026-07-23: 6 new flatten tests incl. all-corner byte-identity; clippy -D warnings clean; full suite passes. Phases 3-7 remain in plan.md; Phase 3 (ops) waits on its Phase 4 producer to avoid dead code; open UI/interaction decisions (smoothness=handle-length vs fillet radius, handle-marker vs gimbal priority, slider-vs-manual-handle readback, Alt-drag semantics) await user ratification before Phase 4+.
